cursorHookPathBug.upstreamIssue: Generated Cursor hook wrappers live in .cursor/hooks and require('../../scripts/...'), which resolves to <repo>/scripts rather than .cursor/scripts where hooks-runtime copies files.
cursorHookPathBug.iafFix: Rewrite generated copies only: require('../../scripts/') -> require('../scripts/'); adapter getPluginRoot() from repo root to .cursor root.
cursorHookPathBug.doNot: Do not add project-root scripts/hooks and scripts/lib symlinks unless a repository already owns those paths and rewriting is unsafe.
